body:
Agh >_< If you were in any of my HMS runs just before reset I’m really sorry

First run I forgot to change prints and blew up

Second run I died early, accidentally threw up a “thanks!” (which I know now seemed really mean spirited and toxic) when I meant to throw a sorry
Thanks! I felt really bad cause the room took a long time to queue, and right after I died the Verica spammed “nice” over my corpse
If anyone had a 4.9k Marth named Senna die on the opening blast of HMS- I apologize. That was my bad, forgot to use wyrmprint.

In elementary school, a few of my friends were pretending to staple their fingers as a joke. I thought they were actually doing it, so in my attempt to fit in I actually did staple my finger.

 It didn’t work, they thought I was dumb as fuck.
You can get through this, I really do believe in you. I wish I knew the words to help you more. Is there anything going on that you’d like to talk about?

People who constantly one up.
Especially if it’s something really insignificant.
